# Realtors Dashboard

Realtors Dashboard publishes source-backed real-estate market information. Its detailed verified-sale coverage is currently focused on New York City; published data is a manually validated snapshot, not live listings or an appraisal. Check each page's coverage and freshness before relying on a figure.

## Public information

- [Home](https://realtorsdashboard.com/): Product overview and links to public pages.
- [Data coverage](https://realtorsdashboard.com/methodology/data-coverage): Geographic and source coverage.
- [Methodology](https://realtorsdashboard.com/methodology/opportunity-score): How opportunity scores are calculated.
- [Free NYC data tools](https://realtorsdashboard.com/tools): ZIP-level market snapshots and benchmarks.
- [Developers](https://realtorsdashboard.com/developers): Documented, API-key-protected partner data API.
- [OpenAPI document](https://realtorsdashboard.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable partner API specification.

## Discovery

- [ARD manifest](https://realtorsdashboard.com/.well-known/ard.json): Discoverable description of the documented partner API.
- [API catalog](https://realtorsdashboard.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 API linkset.

Public pages may be read and summarized subject to the site's published terms. This file does not grant training rights, bypass authentication, or authorize automated access to protected APIs.
